name: Enterprise Fund Committee Special Meeting Agenda May 17, 2023
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA FOR THE
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  May 17, 2023 - 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West - Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Meeting Minutes of April 12, 2023

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS
  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.
  A) FY23/24 Draft Budget Review and Discussion
  B) Purchase Requests and Discussion
  C) Operations Update and Discussion

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted on May 11, 2023 at 11:40 a.m.
